newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK REVISES H1 '97 NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK REVISES H1 '97 NET PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's state-run Agricultural Bank said on Thursday that it had revised its net profit figure for the first half of 1997 to 12.986 million litas from 13.233 million litas.
The bank also said that its assets at the end of June rose to 1.336 billion litas compared to 1.275 billion litas at the beginning of the year.

The bank's spokeswoman Imandra Daukshiene also told Reuters that the loan portfolio of the bank at the end of June was 975.69 million litas, a decline from 1.083 billion litas at the beginning of the year.
The deposits of the bank at the end of June were 722.6 million litas compared to 728.5 million litas at the beginning of the year, Daukshiene said.
201.8 million litas of it were individual deposits, she added.
"The audited net profit results for the first half of 1997 will become known in around a month but we think that the figures might differ only slightly," Daukshiene said.
The audit of the bank, the country's second largest, is being carried out by Deloitte & Touche.
